Mateo Garcia  
Tel Aviv, Israel | +972 54 321 6543 | mateo.garcia@email.com | linkedin.com/in/mateogarcia | github.com/mateogarcia  

A senior data scientist with 12 years of experience driving data-driven decision-making in consulting environments, specializing in scalable analytics solutions for Fortune 500 clients. My career has centered on building robust pipelines, optimizing machine learning models, and translating complex insights into actionable strategies. I have led cross-functional teams to deliver high-impact projects that reduced operational costs, improved user engagement, and enhanced predictive accuracy. My work emphasizes ownership of end-to-end data systems, with a focus on reliability, performance, and cross-team collaboration.  

Technical Skills / Technologies  
Pandas and NumPy form the backbone of my data processing pipelines, where I’ve engineered ETL workflows that reduced data preparation time by 40% in production systems. These tools were pivotal in analyzing large-scale datasets for a financial client, enabling real-time risk assessment models that improved forecast accuracy by 25%. I’ve also leveraged them to design scalable feature engineering frameworks, which streamlined model training and reduced computation costs by 30% in a retail analytics project.  

A/B testing is a core component of my approach to validating hypotheses, with notable success in optimizing marketing campaigns for a global e-commerce platform. By designing and deploying multi-variant tests across 10+ channels, I contributed to a 15% increase in conversion rates. My work in data visualization using Matplotlib and Plotly has produced dashboards that simplify complex datasets for stakeholders, reducing decision-making latency by 20% in two separate client engagements.  

Jupyter notebooks are central to my workflow, serving as both documentation and prototyping tools for models and pipelines. In one instance, I refactored legacy notebooks into modular, version-controlled scripts, improving maintainability and reducing deployment errors. My expertise in REST API design has enabled seamless integration between data systems and client-facing applications, with a recent project achieving 99.9% uptime for a real-time analytics dashboard.  

Microservices architecture is a key focus in building scalable data platforms, particularly in a project where I designed a modular system for processing terabytes of log data. This architecture reduced latency by 35% and allowed for independent scaling of components. Apache Spark and Airflow are integral to my work in orchestrating batch and real-time workflows, with a particular emphasis on fault tolerance and resource optimization.  

Statistical modeling underpins much of my analytical work, from developing predictive models for customer churn to mentoring junior analysts on best practices in hypothesis testing. Python is my primary language, used extensively in automating data pipelines, creating custom tools, and mentoring teams on best practices in code quality and performance.  

Professional Experience / Work History  
As a Senior Data Scientist at Strategic Analytics Group (2017–present), I lead initiatives that integrate machine learning with business intelligence, focusing on large-scale data systems and client-specific analytics. My work includes designing microservices for data ingestion, optimizing Spark clusters for cost efficiency, and deploying A/B testing frameworks that drive product improvements. I’ve also mentored teams in statistical modeling and Python best practices, contributing to a 25% increase in team productivity.  

Prior to this, I was a Staff Data Scientist at Vertex Consulting (2015–2017), where I developed predictive models for supply chain optimization, reducing inventory costs by 18% for a manufacturing client. I also led the design of a REST API for a client’s data warehouse, enabling seamless integration with third-party systems.  

As a Data Scientist at Quantum Analytics (2012–2015), I focused on building scalable data pipelines using Pandas and NumPy, which supported real-time analytics for a healthcare client. My work in feature engineering improved model performance by 20%, while my contributions to A/B testing frameworks helped validate pricing strategies.  

My career began as a Data Analyst at Global Insights LLC (2010–2012), where I developed foundational skills in data analysis and reporting, supporting client projects in market research and competitive intelligence.  

Education  
Master’s in Data Science, Stanford University, 2015  

Projects / Side Projects  
Developed an open-source library for automating feature engineering workflows, adopted by three teams within Strategic Analytics Group. Designed a real-time dashboard using Plotly and Flask for monitoring API performance, which reduced incident response time by 25%.
